title: Bilingual Sexism Classification: Fine-Tuned XLM-RoBERTa and GPT-3.5 Few-Shot Learning
reasoning: The paper benchmarks the detection and classification of sexism (a form of social and ethical harm) in social media content. As the core task involves training and evaluating models on their ability to recognize unethical/prejudiced behavior, it contains a significant component of benchmarking ethical categories.
